exercises.instruction: Fill the gaps to complete these definitions.
items: 1 The air, land and water around us is our ................................. .
2 Dirty air, land and water are all forms of ................................. .
3 The layer of gases which stop dangerous radiation from the sun reaching the earth is called the ................................. ................................. .
4 An increase in world temperature which is ................................. by an increase in carbon dioxide is called ................................. ................................. .
6 A place to put your empty bottles is called a bottle ................................. .

exercises.instruction: Use words from each column to make sentences about how we should help the environment:
Complete these sentences using the word on the right in the correct form.
items: 1 Smoke from factories is ................................. the atmosphere. POLLUTION
2 This is one of many ................................. problems. ENVIRONMENT
3 Pollution is very ................................. to people's health. HARM
4 Fortunately there are now many ................................. groups. CONSERVE
5 Their aim is the ................................. of all natural things. PROTECT
7 The effects of this radiation can be very ................................. . DAMAGE
8 ................................. waste is a big problem. INDUSTRY

exercises.instruction: Fill the gaps in these sentences with words from the box.
items: 1 It is very important that we look after natural ................................. such as water and gas.
2 We need to protect tropical ................................. such as the Amazon.
3 The company were fined for ................................. dangerous chemicals straight into the sea.
4 In big cities, two major sources of pollution are car exhaust ................................. and smoke from ................................. chimneys.
5 There are strict laws about the disposal of nuclear ................................. .
